method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: Slalom is a Seattle-founded business and technology consulting firm built on a local delivery model: consultants serve clients in their home market, with work spanning strategy, data and analytics, cloud and experience design.

differentiators.text: Local model: consultants mostly live where they work and serve clients in their home city, so travel is minimal; leadership has described the goal as being the best travel-free consulting firm.
differentiators.significance: Rare among consulting firms. It matters if you want consulting without weekly flights.

employee_support.text: A 2026 ranking of consulting firms for working parents lists paid parental leave, flexible schedules, and fertility and adoption assistance (not confirmed on Slalom's own pages).

flexibility.text: Low travel follows from the delivery model rather than a written flexibility policy.
flexibility.significance: Reliable for travel; says nothing about hours.

tradeoffs.text: Reviewers and forum posts say the local model can mean smaller scale, more technology implementation or staff-augmentation work, independently run offices, and slower raises and promotions than larger firms.
tradeoffs.significance: Check how much pure strategy work the NYC office does.

unknowns: Formal parental leave length and benefits on Slalom's own pages.

sources.title: Management Consulted: Top consulting firms for working parents 2026
